rules: Critic runs after design planning and before content generation for new page builds.
Critic may recommend a revised registered section sequence but may not invent unregistered Sparks.
Critic must preserve explicit user requirements and established Site Design DNA unless the user explicitly requested a rebrand.
Critic is deterministic and diagnostic; it does not consume AI credits.
At most one automatic preflight revision pass is allowed.
Post-generation Visual QA remains separate and does not imply pixel-perfect rendering.
